scaleBeatText: A woman, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A man, maybe 30s walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.

With Haven grieving, Ashford installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Ashford's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Ashford installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.

The table is green felt under white light. Across it: Vex of the Ninth Ledger — seventeen limbs, zero losses on camera, and a smile like a tax form.
Nobody's beaten Vex on camera. The veterans just say "don't think at the table." They won't say why.
📺 The last roll. Everything staked is in the middle of the table, and the dice are in your hand.
🗣️ Joshua to Sari, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.
🗣️ Xavier to Ella, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

doorOffer.promptHtml: The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes. The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take. ◈ the Feared — 32 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked. (standing: 100) ◇ the Indispensable — The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you. ◈ the Beloved — Viewership 30, fan favor 62 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers. (standing: 100) ◈ the Witness — 6 exposures on the record. The docket is real. (standing: 73) ◈ the Assimilated — Always open. The table takes anyone — that's what makes it a trap, and what makes it safe. (standing: 65) ◈ the Defiant — Defiance 6 on the record. The 'no' is earned. (standing: 44) ◈ the Relay —
